purpose: Review code changes with reproducible findings and safe publication.

trigger: Review the latest changes in this pull request for regressions
Give inline code review comments on PR 57
Inspect this diff for security and correctness
do_not_trigger: Create a new branch and push an implementation
How do I organize an academic bibliography?
Summarize the last deployment without a diff

preflight: Pin base and head SHAs and obtain a complete diff, not only a summary.
Identify whether this is local analysis or remote posting; require approval for posting.
Never read raw credentials from local files or emit secret contents in comments.
workflow: Map findings to concrete changed lines and severity.
Check for test gaps, permissions, data loss and backwards compatibility.
Avoid unfounded high-severity claims; cite code evidence.
Before posting to GitHub, present the exact comments for owner approval.

evidence.how_to_verify: Record the reviewed base/head commit pair and full diff scope.
Provide reproducible file/line evidence or explicit no-findings rationale.
Read back the resulting review ID and comments from the exact PR.

failure_modes: A diff that changed during review requires re-review.
If review publication times out, check remote review IDs before retrying.
